assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness to guide further management
This service addresses the clinical need to evaluate the patient's condition as described in the indication note
